verdict.rationale: Alloy's homepage says it supports KYB and AML checks, which implies it can screen business entities. Nothing in the pack documents linked ownership, beneficial-owner, or association risk context for a business. Entity merging and external entity IDs are record-management features, not ownership context. missing for 10: documented business-entity screening workflow, beneficial ownership/UBO or association graph inspection, linked-party risk context, first-party docs depth, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can screen business entities and inspect their linked ownership or association risk context

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
